name: AI Chatbot for WooCommerce – StoreAgent
author: Josh Kohlbach

sections.description:
🟡 An AI Chatbot for WooCommerce, Trained on Your Own Products

StoreAgent is an AI chatbot for WooCommerce with a full set of AI content tools built in. The chatbot reads your real product catalogue — titles, descriptions, attributes, variations, prices and reviews — and uses it to answer shopper questions in natural conversation, 24/7.

This is not a generic ChatGPT window bolted onto your sidebar. It is a WooCommerce chatbot that knows your stock, your prices and your policies, because it is trained on your store.

  • 💬 AI Chatbot for WooCommerce – Instantly answer shopper questions from your own product data
  • ✍️ AI Product Description Writer – Create SEO-ready copy in seconds
  • 🏷️ AI Product Tag Generator – Suggests optimised product tags
  • ⭐ AI Review Summaries – Turns reviews into powerful social proof
  • 📈 AI Insights Dashboard – See what the chatbot is doing and where your content needs work
  • ⚡ No-Code Setup – Connect your store and the chatbot starts working, no API keys to hunt down

👉 You’ll need a free StoreAgent.ai account to activate the AI features.

🧠 Why Store Owners Choose the StoreAgent Chatbot

✅ Slash Your First-Response Support Times

Turn your WooCommerce store chat into an AI teammate that handles FAQs, product questions and order questions — saving you hours every week.

The StoreAgent AI chatbot slashes first-response times to under 10 seconds and cuts repetitive support questions by 70% or more. Your team stops answering the same five questions over and over, because a conversational chatbot trained on your product data answers them first.

✅ Ship SEO-Ready Product Pages In Seconds

AI product description generation is included for all accounts, even free plans. Answer a couple of questions about your product and watch as our e-commerce trained AI writes the copy in a flash.

✅ Insights Delivered To Your Dashboard

StoreAgent actively surfaces content improvement opportunities and delivers them to your dashboard, then it’s one click to run the AI content tools and implement the change. The ultimate balance between staying in control and letting AI do the hard work.

✅ No More Copy+Paste Or Fiddling With API Keys

Most AI tools feel like you’re babysitting a chat prompt — StoreAgent is different. If you’re still copying and pasting out of a ChatGPT window you’re missing out on e-commerce AI agents that are trained and tuned for store owners. And there are no provider API keys to dig for: connect your store and get started.

💬 What the WooCommerce AI Chatbot Does

🟢 AI Chatbot Widget – A real-time conversational chatbot on your storefront, powered by your own product data
🟢 Product-Aware Conversations – Answers pulled directly from titles, specs, attributes, variations and reviews
🟢 Live Price & Stock Answers – The chatbot reads live product and variation prices at the moment it answers, so it never quotes a stale figure
🟢 Order Lookups – Signed-in shoppers can ask the chatbot about their own orders
🟢 In-Chat Coupon Offers – Let the chatbot offer a coupon to move a hesitant shopper over the line
🟢 Competitor Blocklist – Name the brands you never want your chatbot to mention or recommend
🟢 Tone Control – Set the tone of voice your chatbot replies in
🟢 Multi-Language Detection – The chatbot answers each shopper in their own language
🟢 Full Chat History Logs (Paid Plans) – Read every conversation and mine it for content ideas
🟢 Feedback & Human Escalation – Shoppers rate the chatbot’s answers, and unresolved conversations can be emailed to you as a summary with the customer set as reply-to
🟢 Guest & Logged-In Support – The chatbot works for anonymous visitors, not just account holders
🟢 WooCommerce Integration – Works out of the box with WooCommerce and any WooCommerce-compatible theme

🛒 A Chatbot That Actually Knows Your Store

Most WordPress chatbot plugins ask you to paste content in by hand or point them at a sitemap. StoreAgent indexes your store properly.

Choose which post types feed the chatbot — products, posts, pages, or any combination — and StoreAgent keeps that index in sync as you publish and edit. You can exclude specific pages, watch indexing progress as a live percentage, and re-sync any post type on demand. The chatbot holds off appearing on your storefront until the first index finishes, so a shopper never meets a chatbot that doesn’t know anything yet.

Variable products are handled properly, right down to per-variation pricing, which is where a lot of AI chatbots quietly fall over on a real WooCommerce catalogue.

🎨 Customise the Chatbot to Match Your Brand

Your chatbot should look like it belongs on your site.

  • Set the widget colours, text and greeting to match your brand
  • Choose the chatbot’s position on screen, or open it by default
  • Drop the chatbot inline anywhere with a shortcode instead of a floating bubble
  • Control which post types and pages the chatbot appears on
  • Preview mode to test chatbot answers before your shoppers see them

📊 See What Your Chatbot Is Actually Doing

The StoreAgent dashboard tracks chatbot impressions, conversations and chat → add-to-cart events, and turns them into a KPI band and a conversion funnel. You get a plain-English briefing you can open as a full report or share with your team, so the chatbot stops being a black box.

✍️ AI Content Tools for WooCommerce

Every plan includes a working set of AI agents for the content jobs you keep putting off:

✍️ Product Descriptions – SEO-friendly product copy in seconds
✍️ Category Descriptions – SEO-friendly copy for your category archives
⚡ Short Descriptions – Scroll-stopping blurbs auto-generated from your long copy
🏷️ Product Tags – One-click tag suggestions for better on-site search
⭐ Review Summaries – Turns mountains of reviews into punchy social proof
🖼️ Image Alt Tags – Accessible, descriptive alt text generated from the image itself
🎟️ Coupon Descriptions – Readable coupon copy written for you
🤝 Upsell & Cross-Sell Suggestions – AI-recommended product pairings
🛡️ Review Moderation – An AI agent that triages incoming product reviews for you
❓ Product Questions (Q&A) – Answer shopper questions on the product page, with an Ask a Question widget

Run any agent on a single product, on a sample, or in bulk across your whole catalogue — from the products list, or from WP-CLI. “Complete this product with AI” runs several agents at once to fill out a thin product in one click, and every agent shows its credit cost before you spend anything.

📈 AI Insights for WooCommerce

🔔 Automated Notifications – StoreAgent surfaces quick fixes to your dashboard so you can improve listings without going looking for problems
📈 Content Quality Monitoring – Watches description length and quality, with one-click buttons to fix what it flags

🔌 Works With Your Existing Stack

StoreAgent integrates with WooCommerce Wholesale Suite (and respects your wholesale role conditions), WC Vendors, and SiteGround Optimizer. It also exposes 30 abilities through the WordPress Abilities API, so other AI tools on your site can call StoreAgent’s agents directly.

🌍 Built for WordPress & WooCommerce

  • Install and connect your store in a few minutes
  • Compatible with any WooCommerce-ready theme, including block themes
  • Lightweight, CDN-served assets and GDPR-compliant

🆓 Get Started for Free

The free Lite plan gives you a real taste of everything, including the AI chatbot and the content tools. Keep it as long as you like. Upgrade when you want higher plan limits or the more advanced features.

See all plans at storeagent.ai/pricing/.

Use of Third-Party Services

This plugin connects your store to the StoreAgent.ai service to power the AI chatbot and the AI content tools. A free StoreAgent.ai account is required.

When enabled, the plugin sends the content you select for indexing (for example product titles, descriptions, attributes, prices and reviews) and the messages shoppers type into the chatbot to StoreAgent.ai, which generates the responses and content and returns them to your site.

  • Service: StoreAgent.ai
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

Please make sure this is compatible with your own privacy policy and applicable data protection laws before enabling the chatbot on a live store.

Feedback and Support

If you encounter any issues or have feature suggestions, please reach out to us at support@storeagent.ai.

Have an idea for an AI tool? Let us know.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded zip file (if installing manually).
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to StoreAgent > Settings to connect your StoreAgent.ai account and switch on the chatbot and the AI agents you want.
sections.faq:
Do I need a StoreAgent.ai account to use this chatbot?

Yes, an active StoreAgent.ai account is required — the free plan is enough to run the chatbot. Sign up here.

Is this a free WooCommerce AI chatbot plugin?

Yes. StoreAgent.ai has a free plan with generous inclusions, including the AI chatbot and the AI content tools. You can run a WooCommerce chatbot on your store without paying anything.

Do I need an OpenAI or other provider API key?

No. There are no provider API keys to find, paste or pay for. Your StoreAgent.ai account handles the AI, so the chatbot works as soon as your store is connected.

What is the chatbot trained on?

Your own content. Point StoreAgent at your products, posts and pages and it indexes them for the chatbot, including product titles, descriptions, attributes, variations, prices and reviews. You choose what goes in and what stays out.

How long does it take before the chatbot can answer questions?

Indexing starts as soon as you finish setup, and you can watch it as a live percentage. The chatbot deliberately holds off appearing on your storefront until the first index completes, so shoppers never meet a chatbot that has nothing to work with.

Can the chatbot see live prices and stock?

Yes. Rather than relying only on the indexed copy of your catalogue, the chatbot reads live product and variation prices at the moment it answers, so it doesn’t quote a price you changed last week.

Does the chatbot handle variable products?

Yes, including per-variation pricing. This is a common failure point for AI chatbots on real WooCommerce catalogues, so it is handled explicitly.

Can the chatbot answer questions about a customer’s order?

Yes. The chatbot can look up order data for the signed-in customer asking about it.

Can the chatbot offer a discount?

Yes. You can let the chatbot offer a coupon during a conversation to help a hesitant shopper commit.

Can I stop the chatbot mentioning my competitors?

Yes. You can maintain a per-site blocklist of brands, and the chatbot will never name or recommend them.

Can I control the chatbot’s tone of voice?

Yes. Set the tone you want and the chatbot replies in it, so it sounds like your brand rather than a generic assistant.

Does the chatbot speak other languages?

Yes. The chatbot detects the language a shopper writes in and answers in that language, and you can also set a global language for the store.

Where does the chatbot appear on my site?

Wherever you want it. Show the chatbot as a floating widget, choose its screen position, have it open by default, exclude specific pages, limit it to certain post types, or place it inline anywhere using the shortcode.

Can I customise how the chatbot looks?

Yes. Colours, greeting, button text and position are all configurable from the chatbot settings, and there’s a preview mode so you can test answers and styling before shoppers see them.

Can I read the conversations my chatbot is having?

Yes. Full chat history logs are available on paid plans, and they’re one of the best sources of content ideas you’ll find — real questions, in your customers’ words.

What happens when the chatbot can’t answer?

Shoppers can rate the chatbot’s answers, and unresolved conversations can be emailed to you as a summary with the customer set as reply-to, so you can pick the conversation up personally.

Does the chatbot work for visitors who aren’t logged in?

Yes. The chatbot works for guests as well as logged-in customers.

Can I see whether the chatbot is actually making me money?

The dashboard tracks chatbot impressions, conversations and chat → add-to-cart events, and presents them as KPIs and a conversion funnel, plus a briefing you can open as a full report or share with your team.

Does this chatbot work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes. StoreAgent is compatible with all WooCommerce-compliant themes, including block themes.

Will the chatbot slow my store down?

The frontend assets are lightweight and CDN-served, and the AI itself runs on StoreAgent.ai rather than on your server, so the chatbot isn’t competing with WooCommerce for PHP or database resources.

Is the chatbot GDPR-compliant?

The plugin is built to be GDPR-compliant. Because chatbot conversations are processed by StoreAgent.ai, please review the third-party services section above and your own privacy policy before enabling the chatbot on a live store.

Can I run the AI content tools in bulk?

Yes. Run any agent on one product, on a sample first, or in bulk across your catalogue from the products list or via WP-CLI. Every agent shows its credit cost before you commit.

What else does StoreAgent do besides the chatbot?

A full set of AI agents for product descriptions, category descriptions, short descriptions, product tags, review summaries, image alt tags, coupon descriptions, upsell and cross-sell suggestions, review moderation and product Q&A — plus an insights dashboard that tells you which listings need work.

Does StoreAgent integrate with other plugins?

Yes — WooCommerce Wholesale Suite (respecting your wholesale role conditions), WC Vendors, and SiteGround Optimizer. StoreAgent also exposes 30 abilities via the WordPress Abilities API so other AI tools on your site can use its agents.

How is this different from other AI chatbot plugins?

Most AI chatbot plugins are general-purpose: you hand them a sitemap and hope. StoreAgent is built specifically for WooCommerce, so the chatbot understands products, variations, live prices, orders and coupons — and the same platform also writes your product content. No prompt babysitting, no copying between tools.
sections.changelog:
1.1.7

  • Feature: “Complete this product with AI” — fill out a thin product in one click by running several AI agents together
  • Feature: Name competitors you never want the AI chatbot to mention or recommend, per site
  • Feature: The chatbot now waits until your catalogue has finished indexing before it appears, and shows an “indexing — X% done” progress state instead of answering with nothing
  • Feature: 30 StoreAgent abilities exposed through the WordPress Abilities API, so other AI tools on your site can call them
  • Feature: Every AI agent now shows its credit cost on its settings card, plus a “Run on a sample” option so you can try before you spend
  • Improvement: The chatbot now reports variable-product prices correctly when generating coupon offers
  • Improvement: Removing an AI Memory item is now near-instant instead of waiting an hour
  • Improvement: Your account holder email is shown on the Connection tab
  • Fix: The dashboard counted store-wide paid orders as chatbot conversions, producing impossible close rates
  • Fix: The dashboard setup hero appeared for stores that were already set up, with checklist steps stuck as incomplete
  • Fix: Large AI Memory uploads could run long database queries that pushed CPU hard on busy stores

1.1.6.1

  • Improvement: AI Memory uploads are time-bounded so a large batch can’t be killed part-way through
  • Improvement: Memory uploads now retry sensibly instead of stalling on a rate limit
  • Improvement: Memory ingestion sends one batched request per run instead of one per post
  • Improvement: The chatbot can now see variable-product and variation prices where the parent price is empty
  • Fix: The first memory sync could stall and never finish on low-traffic stores

1.1.6

  • Feature: Redesigned dashboard — KPI band, conversion funnel, briefing hero, guided empty state, and notifications with bulk actions
  • Feature: Chatbot impressions and chat → add-to-cart events are now tracked, powering the dashboard funnel and KPIs
  • Feature: Open the dashboard briefing as a full standalone report, or share it with your team
  • Improvement: First-time setup kicks off the initial memory upload immediately, with a larger first batch
  • Improvement: The setup wizard no longer forces Products for the chatbot — Products, Posts and Pages are all marked Recommended
  • Improvement: The setup wizard pre-selects the content tools for you
  • Improvement: Page slugs now show in the Exclude Specific Pages selector
  • Fix: Saving the chatbot step in onboarding didn’t schedule the product sync
  • Fix: Posts hit by a temporary error were permanently excluded from AI Memory
  • Fix: Duplicate “Generate with AI” buttons in the onboarding wizard footer
  • Fix: Saving feedback settings returned a 500 even though the values saved

1.1.5

  • Feature: Bulk operations now run a credit pre-flight check and offer an upgrade if you’re short
  • Feature: AI agent that recommends upsells and cross-sells for your products
  • Feature: Credit cost feedback toast after every AI action
  • Feature: The chatbot can offer a coupon during a conversation
  • Feature: Usage progress bar in the StoreAgent admin header
  • Improvement: Indexing transparency and manual re-sync for the post types feeding the chatbot
  • Fix: “Generate with AI” on the product short description did nothing when clicked
  • Fix: The AI Memory toggle on the posts list threw a JavaScript error

1.1.4

  • Feature: AI Coupon Description agent
  • Feature: AI agent for automatic product review moderation
  • Feature: WC Vendors product moderation agent
  • Feature: Integration with WooCommerce Wholesale Suite
  • Feature: Email escalation — send a chatbot conversation summary to the admin with the customer as reply-to
  • Feature: Review request on the dashboard after 14 days
  • Feature: Notice when your plan limit is exceeded
  • Improvement: Filter hook to customise the AI memory upload batch size
  • Improvement: The Wholesale Suite integration now respects wholesale role conditions
  • Fix: wp-admin could become inaccessible with StoreAgent active on LiteSpeed servers
  • Fix: “Regenerate with AI” on a review summary returned a missing-parameters error

Older releases are listed in changelog.txt in the plugin folder, and in the plugin’s full version history on WordPress.org.
